whatsappMessage:
Hi Team ICONIK7,

I noticed your gym has stellar 4.9★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries and 24/7 batch details.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, 24/7 timings, aur workout program highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://iconik7.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team ICONIK7, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with 24/7 access details, weight loss & bodybuilding programs, and direct WhatsApp booking for Kankarbagh members. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact studio photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
